summary: Phase 16 review — Google Calendar OAuth + Calendar API integration. Backend: 63 passed, 1 skipped (Slack-not-configured legacy test) across Phases 11-16 = full regression green. All 8 new Phase 16 tests pass: health endpoint lists 9 providers including google_calendar, credentials store accepts google_calendar PUT + masks client_secret, /calendar/start returns the full Google authorize URL with scope=calendar+access_type=offline+prompt=consent+state=<random>, /calendar/status returns {oauth_configured:true,connected:false,primary:null}, /calendar/test returns 503 when not connected, /calendar/events returns 503 when not connected, OAuth callback ALWAYS redirects 302 to /admin/integrations with calendar_error=missing_code (verified curl: 302 -> https://bybloomlabs.com/admin/integrations?calendar_error=missing_code), and POST /admin/milestones/__nonexistent_id/calendar-event returns 503 (not 500) when not connected. Frontend verified live: /admin/integrations renders 'credentials-google_calendar-section' card with 3 inputs (client_id/client_secret/redirect_uri) + Connect/Test/Save buttons + Stored badge; /admin/dashboard renders all 9 health pills including 'health-pill-google_calendar' with CalendarDays icon + 'Google Calendar' label. NOTE the dummy creds were intentionally written by the test (test-client-id-do-not-overwrite.apps.googleusercontent.com) — user must repaste real client_id via UI as agreed.

critical_code_review_comments: google_calendar_client.py — Solid token-refresh design: _persist_tokens never overwrites refresh_token when Google omits it on refresh responses; _refresh_if_needed uses a 60s safety margin; all API calls wrap try/except into a uniform {success, status, data, error} envelope.

google_calendar_routes.py — Callback handler ALWAYS returns RedirectResponse with status_code=302 even when code is missing / error param set / exchange fails / state mismatches. Verified via curl: GET /api/oauth/calendar/callback → 302 Location=https://bybloomlabs.com/admin/integrations?calendar_error=missing_code. State CSRF check is wired (stored_state issued in /start, validated in /callback).

google_calendar_routes.py:60-64 — APP_BASE_URL fallback hard-codes https://bybloomlabs.com when env var missing. This is fine for prod but during preview testing the redirect lands on bybloomlabs.com (which serves the prod build); minor cosmetic — set APP_BASE_URL=https://client-portal-hub-18.preview.emergentagent.com in backend/.env if you want callbacks to land in the preview frontend during a real OAuth dry-run.

google_calendar_routes.py — /admin/integrations/calendar/test correctly returns 503 (not 500) when not connected, AND records a red ping via _record_ping when the actual API call fails. Pattern matches the Slack/ThriveDesk endpoints — good consistency.

google_calendar_routes.py — Milestone sync persists calendar_event_id + calendar_event_link + calendar_synced_at on the milestone doc, so subsequent UI can deep-link to the Google Calendar event without re-fetching the API.
integrations_admin_routes.py — google_calendar correctly added to ALLOWED_CRED_PROVIDERS + health providers list (9 total). Health response includes google_calendar with status reflecting last ping.

IntegrationCredentialsForm.jsx — customConnect handler pops the authorization_url in window.open(...,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer') after fetching /calendar/start. UI shows 'Stored' badge once client_id is saved. Connect/Test/Save all have unique data-testids.
IntegrationsHealthStrip.jsx — google_calendar registered in META with CalendarDays icon. Pill renders with data-testid=health-pill-google_calendar on /admin/dashboard.
Phase 16 has zero new MongoDB _id leaks (verified status endpoint projects out _id, access_token, refresh_token before returning the `stored` block).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11-16 fully green (63/63 backend tests pass + 1 expected skip). The Slack /test endpoint currently returns 502 'no_team' — this is an upstream Slack issue, NOT a regression. The dummy google_calendar credentials written by the Phase 16 test will block any real /calendar/start authorization URL from working with Google's real OAuth servers UNTIL the user repastes the real client_id via the UI. rca_of_the_issue: Slack /test no_team: The webhook URL stored at app_settings.integration_credentials.slack.webhook_url corresponds to a Slack team that no longer exists or has revoked the integration. Slack's incoming-webhook endpoint returns 'no_team' when the workspace/team id encoded in the URL is invalid. Mitigation: Slack admin → Apps → Incoming Webhooks → regenerate URL → paste via /admin/integrations → Slack → Save → click Test connection. Phase 16 Google Calendar dummy creds: test_credentials_accepts_google_calendar PUTs dummy fields by design (per the agent_to_agent_context_note). To restore: open /admin/integrations → Google Calendar card → paste real client_id 728881545908-a752kc3enjgnadmb1c0m6ff90ruick4n.apps.googleusercontent.com + real client_secret → Save.
